implementation_policy: Independent PyTorch implementations of general primitives; no external source copied or imported for N7-N11. Not paper reproductions.

sources.title: Interpretable Functional Koopman Learning with Non-Markovian Closure for Spatiotemporal Systems
sources.venue: ICML 2026; title verified in official downloads list
sources.transfer: N9 uses local ridge-fit latent dynamics and held-out transition residuals, not MERLIN's two-phase functional encoder or Mori-Zwanzig memory closure.

sources.title: Random Controlled Differential Equations
sources.transfer: N10 computes explicit local first-level displacement and antisymmetric level-two path area. It is not a random reservoir, RDE solver, full signature or kernel-limit implementation.

sources.title: Wavelet-based Frame Selection by Detecting Semantic Boundary for Long Video Understanding
sources.transfer: N11 retains signed undecimated Haar detail and second-order modulus envelopes; no keyframe removal, wavelet peak heuristic, MMR or video LLM.

sources.title: MS-Temba: Multi-Scale Temporal Mamba for Understanding Long Untrimmed Videos
sources.transfer: Motivation/overlap check for multi-scale temporal representation, not an implemented Mamba block.

sources.title: Improving Temporal Action Segmentation via Constraint-Aware Decoding
sources.venue: 2026 arXiv preprint; no main-conference acceptance claim
sources.code_status: GitHub API returned 404 on check date; code availability not verified
sources.transfer: N7 uses overlapping latent intervals learned from weak video objectives; it does not use CAD's annotated duration/transition priors or Viterbi decoding.

sources.title: Temporally Consistent Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
sources.transfer: N8 uses balanced latent capacity allocation with anchor-derived margins and feature reconstruction; it does not use ASOT pseudo-labels or Gromov-Wasserstein temporal regularization.

sources.title: Enhancing CLIP-Based Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection via Optimal Transport
sources.venue: ICASSP 2026; not represented here as CCF-A
sources.transfer: Closest-overlap warning: CLIP+OT for WSVAD already exists. N8 does not claim that pairing is new.
